in_sanskrit.name: हरिचरण
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has the feet (steps) of Hari (Vishnu)

in_marathi.name: Haricharan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Haricharan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Haricharan is derived from two Sanskrit words: Hari (God) and Charan (footstep or chariot). The name signifies that the deity's presence or blessings are always with the person and that they are on the divine path.
